test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All journalists are newsreaders.

Some newsreaders are actors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some journalists are actors.

II. Some newsreaders are journalists.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/defd0c8a1fcea1c2171e8e3a9702bc278a8e86788f6e4c6d0237a73091cae2f8.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some journalists are actors → Does not follow (There is no relation between journalists and actors).

II. Some newsreaders are journalists → (There are relations between newsreaders and journalists).

Hence, the correct answer is** "only statement II follows".**
